...This is Gibson's house.
I wonder if Katrina is still angry?
She got upset and threw us out, Gillian. What shall we do?
We've been thrown out again. Please get a grip, Gillian!
We're at the Gibson residence.
This is Gibson's house.
Maybe we should try again later...
Why don't we come back later...
You again? What do you want? Go away!
You again? What do you want? Go away!
Get away from here and stop coming back!
No way! You said that the last time before you started getting fresh.
I don't believe you, you liar!
Get out of here! I hate you!
You promise you'll be good?
I promise. No more of that.
Okay, if you promise. All right. Come in.
You won't try any more of those sly come-ons, right?
No. I promise.
Okay, you can come in.
Katrina! It's me, Gillian! Open up!
Oh, Gillian? Come on in.
Well, hello Gillian. Please come in.
It's you, eh? If you're a real Junker, then answer a few questions for me.
Before that, why don't you show me your Junker ID?
It's you, huh? If you're a real Junker, then you'll have to show me some proof or I won't let you in.
People can say anything they want! I need to see some kind of identification!
Who is it?
Who is it? Who's there?
...give me your name.
Stop messing around! What do you want?
I can't stand this! Who are you?
It is a rather nice looking, early-American type home.
This is the home that Jean was so proud of.
There is light coming from the windows.
It does not appear to be auto-tint glass. The interior is clearly visible.
This is the northern part of the suburbs. There is quite a contrast between this and the southern district.
The lots are zoned rather large out here. The next-door neighbors are a good distance away.
The door on the front is the main entrance. There does not appear to be a door bell.
How about if we try knocking?

I read motion. Someone is inside.
Of course you do. Katrina is home.

You're Katrina, right? I'm a Junker.
I just started down at Junker Headquarters. My name's Gillian Seed.
I'm pretty sure the Chief would have let her know...

Proof...?
Your Junker ID, of course.
I won't believe you unless I can see some proof that you're who you say you are.
I won't believe you unless I can see some proof that you're who you say you are.
No way! You pervert!!
Seems you've taken the joke too far.
I won't believe you unless I can see some proof that you're who you say you are.
Katrina is under a lot of stress right now. She does not seem to want to believe anyone.
You're the only Junker left, right?
Well, it looks genuine to me.
I can't trust you with just that. Tell me how old my father is! If you're a real Junker, you'd know that!
...I see. You really do seem genuine.
That's not enough! Answer the question!
Kyaaah!
What are you doing showing her that?! Honestly...
Sorry, sorry. I just got a little carried away...
Kyaaah! You pervert!!
Please stop!! You're only going to lose her trust!
Katrina! Are you in there?
Katrina! Would you please let us in!
Come on, Katrina! Open the door, will you?
I won't believe you unless I can see some proof...
If you're a Junker, let's see some proof!
...How old is my father?
Choose the numbers with the direction pad. When you give your answer, press the RUN button.
Uh, 55 years old!
I'll say it again! 55 years old!
That's right.
That's still not enough to trust you! Now I'm going to ask you something about myself.
What is it with all these questions?
She knows that, as a Junker, you should have access to Alpha-One.
You saw her data on Jordan, didn't you?
So that means that there should be information on her in Jordan, right?
She's a very smart girl.
First... it's my bust size, right?
Once again... starting with the bust size?
Choose the numbers with the direction pad. When you give your answer, press the RUN button.
You don't need a leading zero, you know.
That's three digits! Get rid of the leading zero.
There's no way it's a single digit!!
Hmph, I'm good at this kind of thing. Straight up... 81!!
Um... 81, that's it!!
...Correct. Now... what about my waist size?
Choose the numbers with the direction pad. When you give your answer, press the RUN button.
This one, of course... ...58!!
...That's right too. ...One more to go. What about my hips?
Choose the numbers with the direction pad. When you give your answer, press the RUN button.
I know this one for sure! ...83!!
All correct! I guess you really are the real thing. Wait, I'll open the door.
What?! ...How rude!
Three digits?! You're joking, right?
You haven't input anything.
Gillian... you have to input something!
Please input something, Gillian!?
How's this! This has got to be it!
This should be about right...
It should be something like this...
You just made a wild guess, didn't you?
You don't have any idea, do you?
Sorry. Wrong answer.
If you are a real Junker, try again.
But you were close.
Wrong, but you're on the right track.
So you were just guessing about dad's age too, huh!
That's totally wrong! I knew it! You're no Junker, are you?
So, Gillian, you like big breasts, huh?
Yeah... I suppose you could say that.
Then what about Jamie...?
Sh-shut up!
Am I really that fat?
It's not that big!
That can't be right!
It's not that small!

Come on, try to remember.

How about data on other women, then? Does it have that, too?

We should go back to check the data on Jordan.
If we check the data files, we should be able to learn the answers.

Try to remember it.
If we check Jordan, we will be able to find out how old Gibson is.
Don't you know, Metal?

We should go back to check the data on Jordan.
If we check Jordan, we should be able to find the answer.
Fine, but don't show me anything like that again...
That's right, Gillian.
This is Gibson's living room.
So you came back to apologize, did you?
Is there something you still need here, Gillian?
Well, I'm a little hesitant to welcome you, but come in.
Oh, Gillian. What do you need today?
Oh, Gillian. Did you forget something?
Is something the matter, Gillian? Anyway, I'm glad to see you.
Come on in. It's good to see you again.
Please come in Gillian. I'm so glad to see you.
Oh... do you have to leave already? Will you please come back again sometime? I'll be waiting for you.
Do you mind if I take a look in your study?
Go ahead...
I'd like to take another look in your study.
Feel free...

All of these are quite impressive pieces.

He has paid a lot of attention to the decor and layout of the place.
Pretty stupid since there were only the two of us here, huh?

None of this stuff is really valuable. He said it was all used.
This is Gibson's study.
Don't worry. It was just a raven.
Oh really...

May I take a look at the garden?

Watch out for Alice, okay?
Alice?
She's my dog.
Oh, okay.

However...
